mission_check.capability: Distinguish the value of legal battle moves from identical retained model-choice states
mission_check.learned_authority: The frozen model owned the original attack; the four replay branches are measurements, not new player decisions or a model update
mission_check.transfer_test: No development or transfer source opened; future promotion still requires disjoint-root comparison against frozen and fixed-heuristic controls
mission_check.cheapest_falsifier: All four legal moves from the first retained state have identical measured battle utility under matched pre-attack timing
mission_check.time_box: One session, one retained train decision, four bounded candidate branches
mission_check.stop_condition: Stop after a trivial first menu, an incomparable timing or boundary, a branch failure, a consumed-root retry request, model fitting, development opening, full run, or publication

interpretation.frame_cost_contrast: Candidate 1 used 204 fewer total frames than candidate 0, but both knocked out the opponent with no damage. This is a narrow execution-cost difference, not demonstrated battle-value generalization.
interpretation.decision: Stop this overleveled source family for now. Triage untouched train sources action-free for more consequential, level-appropriate multi-move battles; require a prospectively bounded scenario and a nontrivial real outcome contrast before fitting or opening development roots.
interpretation.limitation: Only encounter 0 was branched. The other retained encounters were not experimentally tested; the common level-60/61 lead versus level-32 opponents makes them a weak next use of time, but their alternative outcomes are unknown.
